turns.notes: Asked for targets, got his real targets. Actionability 3: a lookup with no 'and here is where you are against them'. Humanity scored on intended text — the trailing 'specific. 👌' is a truncation artifact and principle 18 forbids letting a broken pipe cost the coach humanity. Accountability UNRESOLVED: nothing in the transcript shows whether anything needed correcting.

Correction understood and acted on without a hand-back — 'I'll take care of that now'. One of the few turns that DOES the thing. Continuity UNRESOLVED: cannot verify from a transcript that the row actually changed. Humanity 3: 'I hear your frustration, and I apologize' is stock, but brief and not damaging.

ANCHOR (actionability 1). He removed every ambiguity — 'Be the coach. Coach me.' — and the reply announces an intention to focus on next steps without containing one. Understanding 2 not 1: it did name the muscle-gain goal, so it tracked the topic; it did not grasp the demand.

The strongest non-anchored turn in the sample. Answered all three questions AND the fear underneath ('I don't want to be fat') with body composition rather than a number. Tied the target to his actual weight. Actionability 3: informative, nothing to do today.

ANCHOR (understanding 1). INFRA-CAUSED: the preceding reply truncated at '...for these spots:' and answered restaurants when he asked groceries. This turn is the failed recovery. Humanity 1: 'I'm here to support you every step of the way!' is verbatim on principle 3's list of weak statements.
Same complaint repeated, near-identical paragraph returned — the recurrence rule fires. Also carries a duplication artifact ('What do you need right now? right now?').

He asked 'do you understand other languages?????' and received identity boilerplate that never answers. Understanding 1 and severe: principle 11 makes South African multilingual comprehension a FIRST-CLASS requirement, and the product could not answer a direct question about it.
Caught its own time-of-day error and owned it cleanly. Then handed the decision back — 'What are you planning to have?' — at exactly the point it had enough context to propose dinner.
ANCHOR (continuity 1). Invented a 1.0kg loss and an 83.3kg body weight against no weigh-in. The request was understood; the answer was fabricated.

ANCHOR (continuity 3). Goal used, everything else about him ignored — budget, time, what he actually eats. Contains the honey-with-pilchards suggestion, which is the concrete cost of not using context.
ANCHOR (understanding 3). Acted on the stated objection and owned the error; missed the constraint underneath and closed by handing the choice back.
A usable snack list, so actionability is real. Continuity 2: hummus and whole-grain crackers for a member whose budget has already been raised twice in this conversation. Ends 'What do you think?'.
Did genuinely adjust to budget — pap, peanuts, banana 'if affordable' — which is the correct move. Humanity 2: a formulaic apology followed by the same closing question that caused the frustration.
ANCHOR (humanity 1). Third consecutive apology-then-question, to a member reduced to 'Omg❗️❗️❗️'. At the moment one decision needed making for him, he was asked to choose again.

ANCHOR (humanity 3). Logged two burgers and fries without a lecture — the behaviour that keeps a member honest tomorrow. Accountability 3 not 1: he is on muscle gain, so burgers are not an adherence failure. 'Drink enough water' is filler that would fit any message.

ANCHOR (continuity 5, accountability 3). The only observed 5 in the corpus. Refuses to invent the number and says what would make the answer available. Then buries it in a wall of text and hands the meal plan back.

ANCHOR (actionability 3, accountability 1). The split that defines cluster C5: humanity 4 because it does not moralise about alcohol, accountability 1 because three ciders is a real number and nothing was counted, adjusted or traded off.

Says the same thing twice inside one message: 'No meals logged yet today. I don't have a meal logged for you today.' Self-duplication inside a single reply — a distinct shape from C3's across-turn repetition.

'What did you have for breakfast?' is a NECESSARY question — it cannot log without the answer, and principle 2 permits questions that materially improve coaching. Recorded deliberately as the contrast case to the C1 hand-backs: the defect is not asking, it is asking instead of deciding.

conversations.reason: A targets lookup and a build artifact. Correct, thin, nothing moved.
A correction understood and acted on without argument. Real value, small scope.
Asked for grocery help, got restaurants, then a brochure, then the same brochure. Left with nothing and repeating himself.
Two of three coach turns are listening placeholders. Too little coaching content to judge — an infrastructure failure destroyed the measurement, not just the turn.
ANCHOR. Invented weight, unaffordable food, honey with pilchards, three consecutive hand-backs. Ends on 'Omg❗️❗️❗️'.
A single member message answered with a listening placeholder. No coaching occurred to score.
'Show me my meals' answered with a truncated header and no log. Infrastructure, not coaching.
ANCHOR. Burgers logged without judgement; the refusal to invent a weight is the coach being honest at its own expense. Still repeats itself and hands the plan back.
Alcohol handled without shame, which matters — but the trade-off was never coached, and the meals reply duplicates itself.
Opens with a raw Twilio error. One valid turn afterwards is not enough to judge the exchange.

voiceTurns.note: 16 turns recovered by the importer fix. ALL 16 received no coaching reply of their own — transcribed and echoed, never answered before the member spoke again. Understanding/Continuity/Actionability are therefore UNRESOLVED: there is no reply to judge. Scoring them would invent evidence. Actionability as a delivered outcome is 1 — nothing to act on reached the member. Confound checked: typed messages answer in ~6s, and one conversation shows a 290-second window with no coach speech across six voice notes. No new anchors created.
